Name: JP's Better Inventory - Sort and Actions
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][u]Better Inventory Management[/u][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][i]This object is no use to me, so I pick it up and throw it in the trash can; this one's no use to me either, so I repeat the process over and over and over and over... Oh well, let's keep it simple. [/i][/size][/color][/font][/b]


[b][font=Georgia][size=4][i]This mod includes several cool features that can really help you during your games.[/i][/size][/font][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b][color=#00ff00][font=Georgia]Two ways to quickly delete objects (Configurable): [/font][/color][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Ctrl + Left-click to delete an entire stack. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Ctrl + Right-click to delete them one by one.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Would you rather grab it first? No problem! First, select the object you want to delete, then press:[/b][/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Ctrl to delete an entire stack.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Alt to delete them one by one.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Several filters to organize your items![/b][/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Georgia][size=4]When you click the new secondary button next to the organization button, a smart submenu appears that lets you organize any container in 7 different ways:[/size][/font]


[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Default: ConcernedApe's vanilla style.[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Default+: Sort by IDs.[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Alphabetical: Sorts from A to Z.[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Quantity: By stack size.[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Quality: From Iridium quality and down.[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Category: Groups all minerals together, all seeds together, etc., with alphabetical tie-breaking.[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Price: From most expensive to least expensive (ideal for deciding what to sell).[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][b]Color: Extracts hidden code tags (context tags) and visually sorts items by their color spectrum, sending colorless items to the back.[/b][/font][/*]
[/list][color=#00ffff][size=4][font=Georgia]You can click any option again to reverse the sort order from Ascending to Descending.[/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=4]It works both in your inventory and in chests. [/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Georgia][b]Lock your slots with the L key (by default) to prevent items from being placed in a chest or moved when organizing your inventory.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Now you can move all the items in your inventory to the chest and back again with a single button! Left-click to send everything to the chest, right-click to retrieve everything. [/b][/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][b][i][size=5]That's about it. I'm posting this mod, realizing that I left a few placeholders... Oh well, I'll fix them later.
Use GMCM to make setting up the mod easier![/size]
[/i][/b][/color]

[b][i][u][color=#ffff00][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/u][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there. [/size][/b][size=4]
